column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
Hey... Is there still more?
Yeah.
Aren't we going to go home?
Huh? Go home?!
Why are you deciding that?
Of course not...
Hmph! As long as you get it.
But Kirino, my heart is feeling really bad...
Since there's a chance we can encounter Ayase again!
It has nothing to do with your heart.
I still have lots of places I want to see!
And it's going to be a problem if no one's watching the bags...
Anyway!
You'll be staying with me until the end. Okay?
You even said it like it's for sure...
What? Did you say something?
Do you really feel that much better when you're with me?
Huh?! A-Are you stupid?!
Why are you making it like I want to be with you? You're just mistaking that for the fun I'm having while shopping!
You egotistical siscon!
Huh? What's that?
I just want to go shopping!  I'll make all the decisions, so all you have to do is just be here!
That's not what I mean, umm, that is...
*Sigh*... Well, I understand that it's useful to have someone hold your bags. Yeah, yeah, I got that much.
A-As long as you got it... Hmph.
Anyway! I'll be back. Be a good boy and wait here. If you go anywhere, I'll kill you!
Hey, don't joke about that.
Oh?
Don't worry, I don't want to die yet.
Anyways, go off and shop.
Of course then. You'll be here, right?
Yeah, I got it!
Why do you want me to just stay here like this?!
'Cause otherwise, you'll just go off somewhere.
I won't go anywhere!
Hmm, then that's fine. Okay? If you even move one step, you know what's going to happen, right?
One step?! You don't have to push it that far, right?
Your answer?
Sir!  Yes, Sir!
Idiot! We're not in Akiba here!
Well... that kind of reply was funny, though...
Even one step... What do you mean?!
Anyways, just wait! If you're not here, I'll call you.
Yeah, roger.
